candidates.name: Kaposi sarcoma
support_spans: A woman in her 30s presented with a painful bruise on her hand
An ill-defined indurated blue-green plaque was noted on the dorsum of the left hand
candidates.why: The presentation of a painful bruise and a blue-green plaque on the hand is consistent with Kaposi sarcoma

candidates.name: cavernous hemangioma
support_spans: Radiography: Showed soft tissue swelling but were otherwise unremarkable
Magnetic Resonance Imaging: Showed a heterogeneously fluid hyperintense and T1 heterogeneously hyperintense lesion
candidates.why: The imaging findings are consistent with a vascular lesion such as cavernous hemangioma

candidates.name: Kaposi sarcoma
support_spans: Lesional cells were spindled, ovoid, and epithelioid, with open chromatin, prominent nucleoli, and without mitoses
Immunohistochemistry: Strongly positive for CD34
candidates.why: The histopathological features and immunohistochemistry results are consistent with Kaposi sarcoma
